description: Examines why Carl Sagan’s 1980 Cosmos remains effective science television through its imaginative voyages, Cosmic Calendar and collaborative film craft. Critiques simplified histories, an uncertain example of artificial selection, and the relationship between scientific skepticism and planetary responsibility.
